The release states the transaction would be a majority acquisition via Partners Group's direct private equity program.

new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Indotek Group announced on 2026-06-26 it acquired the remaining 53% stake in Auchan Magyarország Kft. from Auchan Retail International, increasing ownership from 47% to 100%. The business includes Auchan Hungary hypermarkets and long-term brand licence/procurement arrangements with the wider Auchan network.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not a global Auchan ownership change; country-level operator/control change only. Include if the dataset tracks national retail brand operators/franchises.

new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: Instacart announced on 2026-04-14 that it acquired Instaleap, a grocery enablement and fulfillment technology platform with retailer and marketplace customers in nearly 30 countries and a growing presence in Europe. Relevant to grocery/retail platform ownership, but not a European-origin brand.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Not in known_deals. Marked medium because origin is not clearly European despite European market relevance.

new_deal_candidates.why_relevant: CAFOM announced on 2026-03-30 the sale of Habitat brands in France and internationally to its subsidiary Vente-unique.com for €11 million, giving Vente-unique.com full access to the Habitat brand platform for online European furniture/home furnishings markets.
new_deal_candidates.dedupe_note: Potentially internal group transaction because Vente-unique.com is described as a CAFOM subsidiary. Include only if brand/IP-level ownership transfers are tracked separately from ultimate group ownership.
